channel.title: Tallybird changelog
channel.description: Product updates from Tallybird, a fictional company.

item.title: SCIM provisioning for Enterprise
item.description: Create and remove users from your identity provider.

item.title: Audit log export
item.description: Every change to an invoice, with who and when, exportable as CSV.

item.title: SAML single sign-on on Team and Enterprise
item.description: Sign in through Okta, Entra ID or Google Workspace.

item.title: AI auto-categorisation of expenses
item.description: Receipts are read and filed into the right ledger account.

item.title: Public API v2 and webhooks
item.description: A faster API with webhooks for every invoice event.

item.title: iOS app 3.2 with offline invoices
item.description: Draft and send invoices without a connection.

item.title: Custom roles and permissions
item.description: Decide exactly who can approve, send and refund.

item.title: Two-way accounting sync
item.description: Changes made in your ledger now flow back into Tallybird.

item.title: Faster dashboard loading
item.description: The overview now opens in under a second for large accounts.

item.title: Multi-currency invoice reconciliation
item.description: Payments in a different currency are matched and booked automatically.
